Honours the asset's transition rules: a disallowed target is rejected
(returns false). A quantized move is deferred to the next bar and
reported as pending until it commits.

members.name: SetDirectorBinding
members.doc:
Automatic director binding only ever engages when the score carries
Phase nodes — enabling it on a score without them is a no-op, which is
what keeps hand-driven scores hand-driven.

members.name: SetAmbienceResolver
members.signature: static void SetAmbienceResolver(bool (*resolver)(World*, EntityID, std::string& outAmbienceId))
members.doc:
Zone ambience beds: the listener's zone is polled at a low rate and the
bed crossfades whenever the zone's ambience id changes.
Which ambience the listener stands in. Zones belong to a gameplay kit, not to
the music system, so the kit installs this; left null, ambience never changes
on its own and only explicit SetAmbience calls move it. False means "no
zones here", which leaves the current ambience alone.

plugin without plugin discovery (headless tests) call it directly.
